_comment: Live-document character budgets, checked by hooks/session_context.py at every PM session start, resume and compaction. Over budget: condense or archive verbatim in the same change set. 2026-11-11 (this repository): AGENTS.md lowered to stay well under the 24,000-byte rule-file limit of agy (N130); PM_POLICY raised for section 8 (cold read); role packs and CLI wrappers are short by design and have no budget entry. 2026-11-13 (decision 48): AGENTS.md cut to about 12 KB; review rules moved into PM_POLICY; ORCHESTRATION rewritten and given a budget; standing rules S40 and S41 added. USER_STANDING_RULES plus AGENT_PEER_RULES are injected whole by hooks/standing_rules.py and their budgets must sum below its 10,000-character cap, so the peer-rules budget is 1500 (the file is about 500). PM_POLICY raised to 23000 for the Claude Desktop wake path (decision 52).
